authoring.rationale: Notes are edited concurrently; every field declares how concurrent edits merge.
Boards reorder columns and cards concurrently through keyed sequences.
Tasks are saved whole against the revision they were read at.
Workspace settings change only through explicit commands.
The activity log is written by the service and only read by clients.
Replication health is reported by replicas and reset by operators.

value.opaqueReason: The envelope's `$mime` says how to read the value, and `application/json` admits any JSON.

MimeValue.title: A value tagged with the media type that says how to read it

RawPayload.opaqueReason: A replica's own error report, forwarded verbatim for diagnosis.

evidence.opaqueReason: Whatever the reviewer attached; the task only records that it exists.

metadata.opaqueReason: Integrations annotate tasks with their own keys.

payload.opaqueReason: The unsent edit, in whichever entity's shape it was made.
